column1: # tlstore items — hand-maintained. build-catalog.sh adds the digests and the
# serial and writes app/src/main/assets/tlstore/catalog.tsv; never edit that file.
# Tab separated, the catalog's columns minus the digest:
#   name  kind  version  prefixes  source  target  requires  options  summary
# version   - for pkg and bundles; the upstream version for a binary; the
#           launcher tag for a template; latest or a pin for npm-musl
# prefixes  * or a comma list of app packages; one row per (name, prefix set),
#           so the per-edition builds are two rows sharing a name
# source    pkg: package names. binary/file/script: launcher:<repo path>@<tag>
#           or binaries:<asset>@<tag> or a URL. npm-musl: npm:<package>#<exe>
# target    where it lands, ~ allowed; - means the default
# requires  comma list installed first; a bundle's members live here
# options   ;-separated key=value: env=K=V (comma repeats), tz=1, mode=755,
#           args=<what a script is run with>, post=<script item to run after>
# summary   one plain sentence — it is what list and search show the user
# The binaries tag 2026.09.06 is cut by the maintainer after this lands; the two
# musl loaders live under it. Every other asset is already published.
# fastfetch links libandroid-glob and dlopens ImageMagick and Chafa for the
# image logo, so its libraries are a pkg item it requires rather than a note
